Little bird, usual in Australia, but difficult to photograph – because of size, and it is never still – active and acrobatic. Song remarkably strong sweet and varied.
Lichmera indistincta On its way through the fence to the flowers. Photo: Jean
Maroochy Wetlands Sanctuary at Bli Bli, Sunshine Coast, SE Queensland
We are spending time in our garden during the Covid-`9 lockdown 2020. It is a pleasure to see and hear so many birds in our yard. Photo: Jean
